mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index value exceeding 225.0 indicates elevated inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 225.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate sustained consumer confidence and construction activity that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above its 2017 base level (INDPRO > 100.0) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate supply chain efficiency and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 100.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE below 4.5%) signals a tight labor market that supports wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level above 13500.0 (GDPC1 > 13500.0) signals strong economic growth that boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 13500.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
